title: The Brothers' War | Episode 5: As Cruel, As Necessary

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker and chronomage who sends his spirit back through time via the Temporal Anchor to learn how to activate the sylex, and speaks with Urza at the moment of the detonation.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker who serves as Teferi's medium, extending her ghostform around him and relaying what he sees.

entities.name: Saheeli Rai
entities.description: An artificer who built the Temporal Anchor and a replica of the sylex, and runs the machine.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: The artificer who detonated the sylex on Argoth; at the moment of the blast, Teferi speaks to him as he is remade into a planeswalker.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Urza's brother, shown as a half-flesh half-steel grinning machine at the moment of the sylex's detonation.

entities.name: Tawnos
entities.description: Urza's former apprentice, who is released from his coffin and sent west to teach.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A planeswalker defending the tower who tells Kaya and Saheeli the Phyrexians are close.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker whom Teferi expects Kaya to lead with.

entities.name: Wrenn
entities.description: A dryad whose songs Teferi thinks of.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: An archmage among the tower's defenders.

entities.name: Jaya Ballard
entities.description: A dead friend whose death motivates the mission.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: The silver golem planeswalker, gone, who believed his sylex was the real one.

entities.name: Kayla bin-Kroog
entities.description: Urza's wife and author of The Antiquities War, Teferi's key source on the last battle.

entities.name: Hurkyl
entities.description: A woman of the College of Lat-Nam whose meditation made one a conduit for the soul of the land.

entities.name: Feldon
entities.description: A scholar said in one legend to have created or discovered the sylex.

entities.name: Ashnod
entities.description: An artificer said in one legend to have carved the sylex from a qadir's skullcap.

entities.name: Gix
entities.description: A demon said in one legend to have pulled the sylex from Old Phyrexia's ichor well.

entities.name: Jared Carthalion
entities.description: A figure said to have shattered the sylex in one legend.

entities.name: Fallaji boy
entities.description: A dying boy in a Fallaji uniform in Kroog who calls Teferi Father.

entities.name: Sylex
entities.description: The ruinous bowl-shaped artifact whose activation method Teferi seeks; Urza activated it on Argoth.

entities.name: Temporal Anchor
entities.description: Saheeli's machine that projects Teferi's spirit into the past.

entities.name: The Antiquities War
entities.description: Kayla bin-Kroog's epic about the Brothers' War, which Teferi uses to choose his target.

entities.name: Mightstone and Weakstone
entities.description: The two stones reunited in Urza's gem-like eyes.

entities.name: Last Battle
entities.description: The final battle of the Brothers' War on Argoth, where Urza detonated the sylex.

entities.name: Argoth
entities.description: The island where the sylex was used and the war ended.

entities.name: Kroog
entities.description: The city Teferi visits twice in time, once as a lake city and once under siege.

entities.name: Urza's tower
entities.description: The tower where Teferi lies in the coffin and the Phyrexians attack.

entities.name: Tomakul
entities.description: A city near which Teferi witnesses the trench war.

entities.name: Terisiare
entities.description: The continent devastated by the sylex.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The invaders attacking the tower and threatening the Multiverse.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane where the story takes place.

events.summary: In 4562 AR, Teferi lies in a metal coffin and signals Kaya that he is ready to send his spirit back in time after a month of testing.
events.quote: Teferi knocked twice on the inside of the lid. He was ready.

events.summary: Teferi, Kaya and Saheeli plan how to find the true sylex's activation, and Teferi picks The Antiquities War as the key text, aiming for the Last Battle on Argoth.
events.quote: We go here—the last battle of the Brothers' War.

events.summary: Teferi recalls his wound from a Phyrexian creature and that the Phyrexians are at the chamber doors.
events.quote: the Phyrexian creature had wounded him deep

events.summary: Teferi explains Saheeli's insight: send only a spirit back, since silver travel would be like dousing oneself in lamp oil.
events.quote: By extracting one's spirit and casting that back, one would be unable to interact with the past while remaining able to observe

events.summary: Teferi's spirit visits Kroog in 85 AR and sees a warlord scream about ghosts, then moves on.
events.quote: There, he watched a brutal man go mad and scream about ghosts and assassins.

events.summary: Teferi visits Kroog in 28 AR during the attack, and a dying Fallaji boy calls him Father.
events.quote: Father," the boy gasped. The boy died.

events.summary: Teferi walks a charnel trench valley near Tomakul in 44 AR and is seen by a scavenger.
events.quote: until one of them saw him.

events.summary: Back in the present, Teferi tells Kaya and Saheeli he has found blotted time, while the anchor may not survive another trip.
events.quote: I saw it, like a scar. Part of the tapestry blotted out, like ink spilled on a page.

events.summary: Teferi, on a sojourn in 63 AR, watches Urza kneel with the sylex and bleed into it as Mishra's machine charges up the hill, with Kaya relaying the scene.
events.quote: Urza looked up and saw his brother's face, half-torn from the metallic skull beneath, and wept for him.

events.summary: Teferi returns sick and tells the others he almost has it, then goes back for one last attempt as Kaya warns it is brutal.
Teferi finds the Last Battle on Argoth moments before the sylex detonates.
events.quote: Argoth. The Last Battle. Moments before the end of the world, again.

events.summary: Teferi freezes time at the moment of detonation, finds nothing, then takes a reckless risk and stops holding back time; the Multiverse tears open.
In a void at the sylex's blast, Teferi tells the burned Urza about his future as the Planeswalker and the Phyrexians.
events.quote: I need to tell you some things about the future,

events.summary: Urza is remade as a planeswalker as Teferi explains the Phyrexians' return and asks about activating the sylex.
events.quote: Urza was being remade. Stitched together into something else.

events.summary: Urza explains that he activated the sylex by pouring everything into it using Hurkyl's meditation; Teferi realizes the trigger is a person.
events.quote: The trigger to detonate the sylex was not a spell or an artifact—it was a person.

events.summary: The void cracks and breaks and the dark rushes in as Urza starts to ask Teferi's name.
Urza opens Tawnos's coffin on the wrecked coast, says the war is over and his brother is dead, and sends Tawnos west to teach.
events.quote: Tell them what happened here. Tell them what we did, and what we failed to do.

events.summary: Urza reveals his gem eyes and fades away, quoting Kayla's message to remember him as he tried to be; Tawnos walks inland as snow begins to fall.
events.quote: As you were, but as you tried to be,

relations.quote: Kaya was his medium; she was already in his head.

relations.note: Saheeli says she built the anchor.
relations.quote: Teferi, I only built the anchor,

relations.note: Saheeli built a replica of the sylex from Karn's plans.
relations.quote: Saheeli had built an essentially perfect replica from Karn's plans and notes

relations.note: Urza was Teferi's teacher at Tolaria.
relations.quote: I called you my teacher; most know you as 'Planeswalker.'
I need one last task from you, my former student,
Urza looked up and saw his brother's face
Urza's wife, Kayla bin-Kroog, wrote this epic

relations.note: Urza will spend his life fighting the Phyrexians.
relations.quote: You're going to spend your life trying to fight the Phyrexians.

relations.note: Urza says the Phyrexian demon killed his brother long ago.
relations.quote: The demon, the Phyrexian, killed my brother long ago.

relations.note: Urza made Karn, according to Teferi's guess.
relations.quote: made Karn and, Teferi supposed, started this whole affair.
